_note: Switches of the Coaches section only. Names come from coaches.json, classes and times from the timetable (schedule.club.json); nothing about a coach is typed here except which verified extras may show. portraits = coach-<id>.webp files that exist in assets/img (id = lowercase letters of the display name; anyone else gets a monogram). roleLines = coaches whose club role line (coaches.json 'role', verbatim) may be shown: FACTS lists Rey's line in 'What the page may say' (F-COA-02); remove "rey" to hide it (the line carries the words 'Weight loss', an outcome word under the voice guard, which is why the training lane left it out). facts = data-fact ids set on each rendered row for the ledger. A coach without classes in the timetable is never shown (Putu: F-COA-07).
